basis.quote: May explode from heat, shock, friction or contamination.

rows.reason: No dispersion model applies: Guide 111 is the guide for a mixed load or an unidentified cargo, and no release can be modelled for a material nobody has identified. The ERG warns "May explode from heat, shock, friction or contamination"; identify the material, then the brief can route it.
